test_titles: [W01] opens a markdown page from the corpus in a tab and renders its content

test_titles: [W02] restores a markdown highlight over the same text after a restart
[W02] re-finds the highlight after the file was edited outside the app
[W02] reports a highlight as lost rather than moving it to different words
W02.notes: vitest; tests/integration/markdown-highlight.test.ts. The database is closed and reopened from the same path between making the highlight and finding it again, and the anchor is rebuilt from the bytes on disk.

test_titles: [W04] serves the archived page and the resources it references
[W04] refuses a resource path that climbs out of the snapshot
[W04] refuses a symlink inside the snapshot that points out of it
[W04] refuses resources under a file that is not an archived page
[W04] refuses an unknown file id, a malformed one, and a NUL-truncated path
[W04] refuses a remote origin rather than fetching it
[W04] keeps `parseFileId` addressing exactly one file
W04.notes: vitest; tests/integration/snapshot-protocol.test.ts. Real database and real files on disk; only Electron's session is absent. Every widening is tested next to the refusal that bounds it.

test_titles: [W03] renders the archived page as the original, with its own images and CSS
[W03] runs none of the archived page’s scripts and lets none of its requests out
W03.notes: playwright, real Electron; tests/e2e/webpage.spec.ts. The e2e workspace writes a real archived page -- entry document plus assets/page.css and assets/img/figure-1.png -- so the assertions are a computed font only that stylesheet sets and an image with a non-zero naturalWidth, neither of which a fallback rendering could satisfy.

test_titles: [W05] restores a highlight on a saved page over the same text after a restart
[W05] re-finds the highlight after the page was saved again with new text above it
[W05] reports a highlight as lost rather than moving it to different words
[W05] refuses to resolve an anchor against a different rendering of the page
W05.notes: vitest; tests/integration/html-highlight.test.ts. Real archived pages on disk, ingested by the real ZoteroImporter over the recorded fixtures; the database is closed and reopened between making the highlight and finding it again. Re-saving bumps the Zotero item version, because an unchanged version makes the importer skip the item and with it every attachment -- rewriting the file alone would leave a stale hash and the test would assert nothing.
